title: Construction contract dispute · Payment and settlement timeline (illustrative data)

sources.name: Payment clause of the construction contract
sources.quote: The advance is 30% of the contract price, payable within ten days after the commencement notice is issued; progress payments are measured monthly and paid after the supervisor confirms them.

sources.name: Supervisor's review opinion
sources.quote: The amount claimed for the first progress payment matches the measured result; payment is approved.

sources.name: Correspondence between the parties
sources.quote: As the quality rectification is not yet complete, further progress payments are suspended and will be settled together once re-inspection passes.

events.label: Employer pays the advance as agreed
events.detail: The employer paid the advance on the tenth day after the commencement notice was issued, being 30% of the contract price.

events.label: Contractor submits the first progress payment claim
events.detail: The general contractor submitted the first progress payment claim for the measuring period agreed in the contract.

events.label: Supervisor reviews the first progress payment
events.detail: The supervisor checked the measured result, found the claimed amount consistent with it, and issued an opinion approving payment.

events.label: Employer pays the first progress payment
events.detail: The employer paid the first progress payment as agreed after receiving the supervisor's review opinion.

events.label: Subcontractor submits the second progress payment claim
events.detail: The subcontractor forwarded its second progress payment claim to the employer through the general contractor.

events.label: Employer suspends later progress payments
events.detail: On the ground that the quality rectification was not yet complete, the employer suspended further progress payments, to be settled together once re-inspection passes.
